title: Rory and the Sleepy Starflower Glade
verses:
The sun slipped down behind the peaks,
The valley turned to blue,
While Rory led his quiet friends
Across the evening dew.

The gentle wind was calm and cool,
As Nia circled high,
She watched the first pale silver star
Awaken in the sky.

Then Benny took a heavy step,
With slow and steady feet,
While Ricky caught a dancing leaf
That drifted soft and sweet.

Now Tilly hummed a bedtime tune,
To greet the rising night,
While Psittaco curled under moss,
All nestled warm and tight.

Then Rory yawned a happy yawn,
And laid his sleepy head,
Upon a mound of velvet fern,
To make a cozy bed.

The forest whispered soft and low,
Beneath the pale moonbeam,
And Rory closed his drowsy eyes,
To dream a gentle dream.
